content.title: Bill Murray sits with former UConn star at Elite Eight game vs. Duke
content.text: Bill Murray watches the game between the Duke Blue Devils and the UConn Huskies in the first half during the Elite Eight round game of the 2026 NCAA Men's Basketball Tournament held at Capital One Arena on March 29, 2026 in Washington, DC. (Photo by Scott Taetsch/NCAA Photos via Getty Images)Scott Taetsch/NCAA Photos via Getty ImagesPopular American actor Bill Murray has been a consistent presence on UConn men's basketball's NCAA Tournament run, attending his fourth-consecutive game Sunday as the Huskies face Duke in the Elite Eight.Before the game, Murray was seen chatting with former UConn great Cam Spencer, who played a starring role in the Huskies' jaunt to the 2024 national championship, his lone season with the program. Spencer is currently enjoying a breakout sophomore season in the NBA with the Memphis Grizzlies, but Sunday's matchup in Washington, D.C., brings the shooting guard back close to home, as he was raised about an hour west in Davidsonville, Md. Luke Murray has been tasked as the Huskies' "offensive coordinator" during this stretch, masterminding the No. 3 most efficient offense in college basketball during that period. More For YouThe Murray family's presence near the UConn bench should continue if the Huskies reach the Final Four, even after Luke Murray was hired as the next Boston College head coach Thursday afternoon. Hurley confirmed that the assistant coach will remain with the team through the end of the season Friday.
